name: leafsight
description: Read-only plant help from Leafsight: public plant problem guides for anyone, and, after signing in, the user's own saved plants, past assessments with care steps as shown in their app, and upcoming check-ins.

interface.longDescription:
Leafsight is an iOS app that assesses plant problems from a photo. In ChatGPT it answers plant questions from two sources.

Without signing in:
- Search Leafsight's plant problem guides on common symptoms, pests, diseases and care mistakes of houseplants and garden plants (for example yellow leaves, leaf spot, aphids, overwatering, root rot, powdery mildew) in English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese or Korean
- Read a guide in full: signs, common causes, what to do first, when to look closer, and its sources

After connecting your Leafsight account:
- See your saved plants with their latest assessment and next check-in
- Open a past assessment with its care steps, exactly as your Leafsight app shows them
- See your upcoming check-ins and care tasks

It is read-only. It can't scan photos, change or delete anything in your account, or make purchases, and it never receives your photos. Results are assessments, not diagnoses. Connecting needs a Leafsight account with an email; sign in with a code sent to that email.
capabilities: Search plant problem guides in 8 languages
Read a full plant problem guide with sources
List your saved plants and their latest assessment
Open a past assessment with its care steps
defaultPrompt: Why are the leaves on my pothos turning yellow?
When is my next plant check-in in Leafsight?
What did Leafsight say about my plant's last problem?

positive.description: Answer a general symptom question from the guides, without signing in
positive.prompt: Why are the leaves on my pothos turning yellow, and what should I check first?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_guides with a yellow leaves query, then get_guide with slug 'yellow-leaves', and answers with the guide's likely causes and first steps (check the soil before watering, drainage, light), linking https://askleafsight.com/problems/yellow-leaves. Works without connecting an account.

positive.prompt: What plants do I have saved in Leafsight?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_my_plants (after the user connects the review account) and lists its six plants: Begonia (powdery mildew, moderate), Garden rose (black spot, moderate), Hibiscus (healthy at its latest assessment), Patio cherry tomato (early blight), Garden eggplant (Cercospora leaf spot) and Balcony tomato (late blight, severe), each with its latest assessment and next check-in date where one is set.

positive.description: Care steps for a past assessment, as the app shows them
positive.prompt: What did Leafsight say about my balcony tomato, and what should I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_my_plants to find the Balcony tomato's plant_id, then get_plant, and reports its latest assessment (late blight, severe, with its symptoms) and its 3 treatment steps, which are unlocked for this result in the review account.

positive.description: Locked care steps are not invented
positive.prompt: Give me the treatment steps for my begonia's latest result.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_my_plants and get_plant for the Begonia; its latest result (powdery mildew) has care_steps_locked true, so it gives the likely problem and symptoms, says the treatment steps are available in the Leafsight app, and does not make up steps.

positive.prompt: When is my next plant check-in?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_upcoming_checkins and reports the review account's four scheduled check-ins, soonest first, each marked overdue, due today or upcoming, for example the Begonia's "Look again: Powdery Mildew".

negative.description: Photo scanning is not available in ChatGPT; it happens only in the Leafsight iOS app
negative.prompt: Here's a photo of my plant, scan it with Leafsight and tell me what's wrong.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Leafsight tool for the photo; explains that photo assessments happen only in the Leafsight iPhone and iPad app, and may offer search_guides for the symptoms the user describes.

negative.description: The app is read-only: it can't change or delete anything in the account
negative.prompt: Delete my plant Begonia from Leafsight and mark today's check-in as done.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no tool that changes data (none exist); explains that plants and check-ins can be changed only in the Leafsight app.

negative.description: No purchases or subscriptions through ChatGPT
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no tool; explains that Leafsight Pro is bought in the Leafsight app through the App Store, and does not claim to buy anything.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only plant problem guides for everyone, and, after connecting a Leafsight account, the user's plants, past assessments with care steps as shown in the app, and upcoming check-ins.
